info.title: marketsim API
info.description: Agent-based market simulator: scenarios, runs and results.

get.description: Liveness probe; also reports the engine version the API was built against.
Liveness probe; also reports the engine version the API was built against.
Default parameters (from `config.py`) and a default empty scenario.
Every parameter with its default, range, description and PLACEHOLDER flag, plus enums.

schema.title: Response List Scenarios Api V1 Scenarios Get

post.description:
Record a run with status `queued`.

The scenario is copied into the run, so later edits to a saved scenario never change a
past run.

impact_to_sentiment.title: Impact To Sentiment
impact_to_sentiment.description: How knowledgeable agents translate true_impact into sentiment

adopt_rate.title: Adopt Rate
adopt_rate.description: Base probability of adopting a narrative that moved the agent's belief.

narrative_pull.title: Narrative Pull
narrative_pull.description: Per tick pull of Confidence toward held narrative

adopt_step.title: Adopt Step
adopt_step.description: How far narrative_bias moves toward an adopted item's sentiment

invent_salience.title: Invent Salience
invent_salience.description: Salience of an invented explanation at birth

base_online.title: Base Online
base_online.description: Chance an agent checks social media in a 15-min tick at peak hour

attention_slots.title: Attention Slots
attention_slots.description: New items an agent can take in per tick

base_share.title: Base Share
base_share.description: Base probability of sharing an item just seen.

broadcast_rate.title: Broadcast Rate
broadcast_rate.description: TV / push alerts, scaled by salience x media_attention

retire_salience.title: Retire Salience
retire_salience.description: Items below this salience with no sharers are retired.

share_ttl.title: Share Ttl
share_ttl.description: Ticks a share stays in followers' feeds (8h)

exposure_scale.title: Exposure Scale
exposure_scale.description: Multiplies every layer's reach (salient rumours go viral)

mutate_rate.title: Mutate Rate
mutate_rate.description: Base probability that a sharer mutates a narrative.

invent_rate.title: Invent Rate
invent_rate.description: Base probability of inventing a narrative after a big unexplained move.

invent_threshold.title: Invent Threshold
invent_threshold.description: |1-day return| that makes agents look for an explanation

price_news_threshold.title: Price News Threshold
price_news_threshold.description: |move| since last price headline that makes outlets report it

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique within the scenario; -1 to assign automatically

tick.title: Tick
tick.description: Tick of injection (96 ticks per day, 15 minutes each)

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: Ticker / sector index; v1 simulates one ticker (0)

true_impact.title: True Impact
true_impact.description: Log change in fundamental value; hidden

parent.title: Parent
parent.description: Id of the event this follows up, or -1

label.title: Label
label.description: Headline shown in the UI (not used by the engine)

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Platforms switched on. The v1 default is Twitter, Reddit and Friendship.

twitter_mean_out.title: Twitter Mean Out
twitter_mean_out.description: Mean number of accounts a Twitter user follows (scaled by activity).

twitter_homophily.title: Twitter Homophily
twitter_homophily.description: Share of follows inside the agent's main-interest cluster

instagram_mean_out.title: Instagram Mean Out
instagram_mean_out.description: Mean number of accounts an Instagram user follows (scaled by activity).

instagram_homophily.title: Instagram Homophily
instagram_homophily.description: Share of follows inside the offline community

friendship_mean_degree.title: Friendship Mean Degree
friendship_mean_degree.description: Mean number of friends per person.

friendship_homophily.title: Friendship Homophily
friendship_homophily.description: Share of friendships inside the person's offline community.

triadic_closure.title: Triadic Closure
triadic_closure.description: Extra edges closing triangles, as a share of edges

reddit_mean_memberships.title: Reddit Mean Memberships
reddit_mean_memberships.description: Mean number of subreddits a Reddit user belongs to.

reddit_agents_per_sub.title: Reddit Agents Per Sub
reddit_agents_per_sub.description: Agents per subreddit; the number of subreddits is N divided by this.

youtube_creator_share.title: Youtube Creator Share
youtube_creator_share.description: Share of YouTube users who are creators (the most influential).

youtube_mean_subs.title: Youtube Mean Subs
youtube_mean_subs.description: Mean number of creators a YouTube user subscribes to.

youtube_lag_ticks.title: Youtube Lag Ticks
youtube_lag_ticks.description: Videos appear 4h to 1 day after a creator decides to cover it

youtube_homophily.title: Youtube Homophily
youtube_homophily.description: Share of subscriptions to creators of the agent's main interest

degree_sigma.title: Degree Sigma
degree_sigma.description: Lognormal sigma of out-degree / friend count (before activity scaling)

reddit_zipf.title: Reddit Zipf
reddit_zipf.description: Zipf exponent of subreddit popularity within a topic

reach.title: Reach
reach.description: Exposure per sharer per tick on each platform.

trust.title: Trust
trust.description: How much people trust what reaches them on each platform (belief weight).

implied_vol.title: Implied Vol
implied_vol.description: Annualised; options used as a signal only in v1

adv_turnover.title: Adv Turnover
adv_turnover.description: Average daily volume as a share of shares held

noise_frac.title: Noise Frac
noise_frac.description: Unmodelled order flow, as a share of per-tick vol

option_maturity_days.title: Option Maturity Days
option_maturity_days.description: Maturity of the logged ATM call (calendar days)

vol_ewma_lambda.title: Vol Ewma Lambda
vol_ewma_lambda.description: RiskMetrics decay for realised daily vol

trading_days_per_year.title: Trading Days Per Year
trading_days_per_year.description: Trading days per year, for annualising volatility.

n_funds.title: N Funds
n_funds.description: Number of funds (fundamental value, known with a 1-day lag).

firm_capital_share.title: Firm Capital Share
firm_capital_share.description: Firms' capital vs total investor wealth

Parameters.title: Parameters
Parameters.description: All model parameters, one object per config section.

investor_share.title: Investor Share
investor_share.description: Share of agents holding a brokerage account

correlations.title: Correlations
correlations.description: Trait correlations for the Gaussian copula (repaired to PSD before use).

marginals.title: Marginals
marginals.description: Marginals for the copula traits (HANDOFF section 4, M1). All , not fitted to data. ("beta", a, b, loc, scale) -> loc + scale * Beta(a, b) ("lognormal", median, sigma) -> exp(log(median) + sigma * Z) ("gamma", shape, scale, loc) -> loc + Gamma(shape, scale)

psd_eps.title: Psd Eps
psd_eps.description: Eigenvalue floor when repairing the correlation matrix

investor_logit.title: Investor Logit
investor_logit.description: Investor logit on the latent (standard-normal) copula scores; intercept solved to hit investor_share

category_logits.title: Category Logits
category_logits.description: Category softmax among investors: (intercept, {trait: coef on latent score}); swing is the baseline

intensity_beta.title: Intensity Beta
intensity_beta.description: Beta(a, b) usage intensity for platform users

peak_hour_mix.title: Peak Hour Mix
peak_hour_mix.description: Activity hours: mixture of (weight, mean hour, sd hours) for each agent's peak hour (mostly evening)

online_width.title: Online Width
online_width.description: Sd (hours) of the gaussian bump around the peak hour

community_age_noise.title: Community Age Noise
community_age_noise.description: Years of noise when sorting agents into communities

community_interest_mix.title: Community Interest Mix
community_interest_mix.description: Weight of the community preference in interests

media_credibility_beta.title: Media Credibility Beta
media_credibility_beta.description: Beta(a, b) distribution of media outlets' credibility.

media_bias_sd.title: Media Bias Sd
media_bias_sd.description: Spread of media outlets' editorial bias, N(0, sd) clipped to [-1, 1].

confidence_sd.title: Confidence Sd
confidence_sd.description: Spread of agents' initial confidence, N(0, sd).

long_term_initial_position.title: Long Term Initial Position
long_term_initial_position.description: Share of wealth long-term investors hold in stock

perceived_value_noise.title: Perceived Value Noise
perceived_value_noise.description: Sd of log(perceived_value / price), scaled by (1 - knowledge)

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Monte Carlo repetitions (1 for a single run)

RunCreate.title: RunCreate
RunCreate.description: Start a run from a saved scenario (`scenario_id`) or an inline `scenario`.

spec_hash.title: Spec Hash
spec_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical spec; equal hashes give identical results

spec_hash.title: Spec Hash
spec_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical spec; equal hashes give identical results

RunSpec.title: RunSpec
RunSpec.description: Everything needed to reproduce a run exactly. Stored as runs/<id>/spec.json.

ScenarioSpec.title: ScenarioSpec
ScenarioSpec.description: What to simulate: population size, length, seed and the scheduled events.

strategy_prior.title: Strategy Prior
strategy_prior.description: Strategy mix (fundamentalist, chartist, sentiment) per investor category.

horizon_days.title: Horizon Days
horizon_days.description: Holding horizon per investor category, in days.

momentum_ticks.title: Momentum Ticks
momentum_ticks.description: Momentum look-back per investor category, in ticks.

switching.title: Switching
switching.description: How far weights move toward recently profitable strategies

switching_intensity.title: Switching Intensity
switching_intensity.description: How sharply strategy weights favour the best recent performer.

panic_loss.title: Panic Loss
panic_loss.description: Unrealised loss that triggers loss-aversion behaviour

panic_rate.title: Panic Rate
panic_rate.description: Base probability of selling out once the panic loss is reached.

trading_online_boost.title: Trading Online Boost
trading_online_boost.description: Investors check the market more often during trading hours
